subject: Fix Override Specifier and Suppress MacOS Compiler Warning (#496)
reason: The change modifies only CMakeLists.txt: it reformats the SAN_BUILD cache variable and sanitizer messages, and adds -Wno-defaulted-function-deleted on Apple builds to suppress a macOS compiler warning. The diff is complete (diff_truncated: false) and contains no C++ source changes, so no runtime behaviour, command reply, indexing, replication or persistence path is affected — it is purely a build/CI change that needs no scenario.
